info.name: Oracle GoldenGate Cloud Service API
info.description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) API for managing GoldenGate deployments, connections, deployment backups, database registrations, pipelines, connection assignments, certificates, and work requests in OCI. This is the OCI control-plane API (version 20200407) for provisioning and managing GoldenGate cloud resources. Based on the OCI GoldenGate API documentation and Python SDK reference.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Support
